note: Review round 4: the 28 likely-duplicate pairs of rev 3, each decided on the pack photos (both retailers' pictures viewed side by side, one enlarged) and on the sale format. 17 merged, 11 kept separate.

decisions.evidence: Both packs are the Mama Mia 'Pain de mie Nature' bag, same 14-slice format.
Both are the Daily'n marbled loaf cake in the same wrapper (chocolate/vanilla marbling, Daily'n band), 700 g; Carrefour calls it 'Grand Mère', Géant 'Cake'.
Both packs read 'Slice – Recette Grand-Mère – chocolat vanille' (Daily'n 40 g); only the wrapper print generation differs.
Carrefour/OFF pack reads 'Demi-écrémé' (Délice UHT 1 L); the Géant record names it '1/2 écrémé' 1 L. The Géant carton art does not show the variant, so the variant rests on the two source names.

Both packs are the Natilait 'mon Dessert' chocolate cup (Géant cup reads 'Dessert Chocolat'), 100 g; Aziza's picture is the same cup in a set.

Géant cup reads 'mon Dessert Vanille' (Natilait, 100 g); Aziza names it 'Mon dessert vanille'.
Both packs are the L'Epi d'Or 'Farine pâtissière' 1 kg bag.
Both cans read 'SICAM – Harissa du Cap Bon – 135 g'.
